pageProps.title: Foster & Black Specialty Coffee Melbourne Central
pageProps.review: We spotted this well-known cafe while passing by and ordered a Long Black. We'd gotten quite wet in the rain, so we took a short break to dry off. Honestly, I'm not sure whether the coffee was exceptionally good, but the timing for a rest was perfect.
pageProps.content: ## Review We spotted this well-known cafe while passing by and ordered a Long Black. We'd gotten quite wet in the rain, so we took a short break to dry off. Honestly, I'm not sure whether the coffee was exceptionally good, but the timing for a rest was perfect. It's a place that takes its equipment seriously, reportedly using the `La Marzocco KB90` machine. ## Pictures
